name: Yamaha RD500LC / RZV500R
engine: 499 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke V4, power valves
intro: Yamaha's road-going V4 two-stroke based on its GP bikes. Rare and valuable, with parts to match.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
